heroHeadline: Cuba's Grid Collapses Nationwide as Washington Sanctions Castro's Grandson
heroSubtitle: Tracking the Cuban Revolution, Cold War confrontations, US embargo, Soviet collapse, and Cuba's ongoing political and economic crises from 1959 to the present — now including the 2026 US energy blockade that has triggered an eighth nationwide grid collapse, a fresh round of US sanctions, and a record 1,339 political prisoners
footerNote: Data sourced from US State Department, Cuban government records, Wilson Center Digital Archive, National Security Archive, ECLAC, Human Rights Watch, Prisoners Defenders, 14ymedio, CiberCuba, Al Jazeera, CNN, NPR, Fortune, and Miami Herald
